results.title: AdHelm CLI: An Open Sourced CLI for Managing Ads | Product Hunt
results.content:
Hey Product Hunt 👋 Some people fish. Some do woodcraft. Some collect stamps. My dopamine goes to building things that make my everyday life a little easier. This time it might make yours easier too, if you're a marketer. AdHelm is a free, open-source command-line tool that gives Claude Code and Codex access to your ad accounts: Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, Reddit, and more. You ask your agent, "How did Google Ads do last week? Anything worth fixing?" It runs the AdHelm commands, reads your report, and audits the account. Every finding shows what it read and the evidence behind it. A few things I cared about: • It runs on your machine. No hosted service, no telemetry, no account to sign up for. • Your keys stay in your OS keychain. That's a bit more setup for you, but nothing sits on a server [...] a bit more setup for you, but nothing sits on a server I run. • Version 0.1.1 reads, audits, and recommends. It doesn't change anything in your accounts. The recommendations come from agent skills built on years of B2B marketing experience. It's early. Like pre-alpha early. I've tested it on a few accounts, and I expect you'll find things to improve. That's why I'm here. So try it on your own accounts and tell me what breaks. results.title: Troubleshooting | Helm
results.content:
+ Tiller installations stopped working and access is denied
  + Uninstall skips some resources with "not owned by this release" warning [...] Troubleshooting
  + I am getting a warning about "Unable to get an update from the "stable" chart repository"
  + I am getting the warning 'WARNING: "kubernetes-charts.storage.googleapis.com" is deprecated for "stable" and will be deleted Nov. 13, 2020.'
  + When I add a Helm repo, I get the error 'Error: Repo " is no longer available'
  + On GKE (Google Container Engine) I get "No SSH tunnels currently open"
  + After migration from Helm 2, `helm list` shows only some (or none) of my releases
  + On macOS, the file `/etc/.mdns_debug` is accessed. Why?
  + helm repo add fails when it used to work
  + Enabling Kubernetes client logging
  + [Rollback fails with "no [Resource] with the name '[name]' found"](#rollback-fails-with-no-resource-with-the-name-name-found) [...] The Helm Chart repositories are no longer supported after a year-long deprecation period. Archives for these repositories are available at ` and ` however they will no longer receive updates. The command `helm repo add` will not let you add the old URLs unless you specify `--use-deprecated-repos`.

### On GKE (Google Container Engine) I get "No SSH tunnels currently open"​ I get ")

```

Error: Error forwarding ports: error upgrading connection: No SSH tunnels currently open. Were the targets able to accept an ssh-key for user "gke-[redacted]"?

```

Another variation of the error message is:

```

Unable to connect to the server: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority

```

The issue is that your local Kubernetes config file must have the correct credentials.
